intro: Frames from Lost Reels as it runs: the cinema, the bus, the Editing Studio and the forest between them, the crew and the Splicer. Only the key art section is retouched.

groups.title: In-game screenshots
groups.note: Captured in the game (Unreal Engine 5.9), no paint-overs.

items.caption: The Splicer waits at the end of a studio corridor, caught in the flashlight beam.
Closer. The Splicer stands still while the light is on it.
The camcorder's LCD records what the crew sees: here, the Splicer in a doorway.
Two of the crew head into the forest at dusk, flashlights on.
The crew around the campfire.
Night fog at the camp: silhouettes, a lantern and a folding chair.
The cinema at dusk, its projector beam pointing up into the sky.
The cinema from above, wrapped in fog.
The cinema by day: hazy sun, dark pines and the beam that guides everyone home.
EDITING STUDIO letters on the roof, a street lamp in the fog and something under the tree.
The road past the Editing Studio and its rooftop letters.
The road to the clearing, autumn trees on both sides.
The north road and the crew bus. Trees and grass sway in the wind.
The duck bush: rubber ducks on bare twigs, a small joke near the bus.
The bus monitor shows a teammate's camera; the dial phone switches between feeds.
The CRT in the bus, the phone and the camcorder: the crew's base between runs.
The camcorder held low in the cinema; its LCD keeps showing the live picture.
Inside the bus by day, the camcorder LCD in colour.
The siren: two minutes of daylight left, everyone back to the cinema.
The projector in the cinema, waiting for reels and batteries.
Three reels delivered: the rack next to the projector fills up.
A crew member with a flashlight in the cinema lobby.
The trumpet makes noise on purpose, to pull the Splicer away from the others.
Talking on the walkie-talkie, flashlight in the other hand.
The crew line-up in the cinema: one jacket per player.
Running past the projector.
The padded red door of the Editing Studio.
The cinema's inner doors, opened by a teammate.
Day 3: the doors open onto the street and the forest.
At night the Splicer waits outside the studio.
A mustard-painted studio room with props and a mannequin.
A faded mint room, lit only by the flashlight.
Notes left on a studio mixing desk: a memo and a Making Of card.
The Found Notes journal: a diary page from the crew's story.
The main menu: Play, Extras, Found Notes, Credits.
CUT! The run is over, and the cinema screen says so.
The Splicer's catch pose.
